entries.5c045e221dbe18b7: Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥942,505 million, up ¥184,866 million (24.4%) from the previous fiscal year. Looking at net sales to external customers by segment, the housing business was ¥431,723 million, the urban development business was ¥318,711 million, the operation and management business was ¥109,653 million, the brokerage and CRE business was ¥62,322 million, the asset management business was ¥16,102 million, the overseas business was ¥3,718 million, and other was ¥275 million. Net sales increased in the housing business due to a rise in the average price of condominiums for sale and an increase in sales of income-producing real estate, and in the urban development business due to an increase in sales of income-producing real estate. Net sales decreased in the overseas business mainly because the number of condominiums for sale recorded in Vietnam decreased.
